name: WuWei
headerMeta: Heroic era · Melee infantry (Polearm) · special · 235 leadership

origin.text: Unlocked through the WuWei unit-tree line - four stages of Siege, Expedition and Open World challenges. Confirmed in-thread as a fixed, universal list, not personalized per player.
unlock: Stage 1: Siege objectives - trebuchet or capture-point interrupts, K/D 1+, top-5 placement, B+/A+ battle ratings - plus hero leveling, daily quests, and Expedition wins and troop kills.
Stage 2: 'Shatter the ranks' badge, Expedition troop kills, Open World loot and fief quests, Siege K/A and capture-point or ladder objectives, artillery kills.
Stage 3, partial - the source message cuts off here: Bloodbath or No Quarter badge, artillery or unit kills, death-match kills, trebuchet capture points.

Stage 4: trebuchet kill-value objectives, field-battle unit-value totals, hattrick or deadly-century badges, group kill totals, hero level-ups, daily tasks, ranked battles or siege wins, rebel-camp wins.

pitch: A widely-considered-overtuned purple-tier infantry unit whose entire winning pattern is one dead-simple two-button combo — no hidden trick, no special positioning required. Its real counters are the things that stop the combo from ever landing: block, spacing, burst damage, or ranged units like Rattan Marksmen that can hit it before it closes.

doctrines.name: Wuwei Unique Doctrine
doctrines.effect: Brutal Sweep restores 10% max HP. Mandatory per Amya.

doctrines.name: Epic Combat Doctrine
doctrines.effect: After every 3 attacks: next attack's DMG +11%. Every 6 attacks: restores 15% max HP. Every 9 attacks: 2.5s CC immunity.

doctrines.name: Toughness Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: -33% DMG taken on first hit, scaling down over 8 hits until it expires.

doctrines.name: Flat DMG-reduction doctrines (e.g. the −5% one)
doctrines.note: you're getting one-shot anyway, so it doesn't help

veterancy.label: Bottom line
veterancy.body: Community-recommended alternative for its per-level health-regen bonus, valued for survivability — secondhand advice the presenter hadn't personally validated.

battleRole.positioning: Go in with your frontline rather than solo-committing; don't over-extend, and it's fine to X-move back before pressing 1-2 again if you push too far. {1} Basic ally frontline support (meat shields nearby) is enough to keep the loop running — it doesn't need precise formation play. {2}
battleRole.tips: Against heavy-armor targets, let skill 1 land first to apply its armor debuff, then resume spamming 1 and 2. {1} Performs at a very high level even undermaxed — an under-leveled copy with only a moderate doctrine set still cleared 40-60+ unit kills per engagement in shown clips. {2}

cards.name: Rattan Marksmen
cards.why: ranged hits from outside its effective range punish it before the loop starts

cards.name: WuWei (mirror)
cards.why: the other practical threat named alongside strong hero plays

cards.name: Palace Guards
cards.why: walk up, brace before impact, wait out the sweep, unbrace for full-unit damage — winnable decisively if played correctly, not just a costly trade

matchups.pressure: You pressure: nearly everything, given free DPS uptime — Amya's guide names no specific unit this counters, only "insane dmg if free dps."
matchups.siblings: Halberd Elite is a boosted WuWei - trades better into block but has less range, so it wipes slower but hits harder.

controls.notes: Press 1, then quickly press 2, against any cluster — killing enemies resets both cooldowns, so the loop repeats as long as targets are in range. {1}{2} No deeper combo or timing trick is being withheld: the simplicity of the 1-then-2 loop is presented as the unit's defining (and, per one presenter, overtuned) characteristic. {2}
